text:
Rina: noticing ~130 GPU pods Pending in ap-southeast1 after last night's placement tweaks. Lots of "prebind latch" waits and NV attach queue saturation.
SRE-Bot: alert: gpu-prod/ap-southeast1 pending=131 link=https://console/alerts/1766123456
Omar: Which tweak? We enabled anchor-affinity + tighter prebind in the rollout.
Grace: Logs show repeated prebind waits and conntrack attach timeouts:
```
I0612 23:42:10 prebind.go: latch wait=5.2s pod=train-7 node=gpux-apse1b-04
W0612 23:42:12 attach: conntrack timeout nvattach queue=100/100
E0612 23:42:15 scheduler: eviction triggered due to attach-failures
```
Rina: Ops, can we do a per-region quick revert of the prebind tightening? Prefer not to touch anchor-affinity yet.
Ops: starting targeted rollback to ap-southeast1 (canary nodes only) now.
Scheduler-Team: short-term mitigation idea: enable latebind-fallback when nvattach backpressure > 80% and shard nvattach queues by kubelet to reduce head-of-line blocking.
Omar: Also suggest bumping kubelet nvattach-concurrency from 4->12 in apac and enabling a temporary attach-queue sharding flag.
Ops: rolling prebind revert canary finished at 1766123520. pending dropped 131 -> 58 within 90s.
Grace: after revert + small attach-concurrency canary (10% nodes), pending fell to ~18 and eviction churn stopped.
Rina: filing follow-up INF ticket to add region telemetry gating for prebind heuristics and to prototype attach-queue sharding. Include cost calc for idle GPU minutes.
SRE-Bot: incident marked mitigated at 1766123665. Monitoring for 30m.
Omar: will draft RFC for latebind-fallback behavior and queue sharding.
